title: Synthetic Tabular Data Generation using GReaT & TabDDPM
summary: A project that generates synthetic tabular data for a bank customer churn dataset using GReaT (LLM-based) and TabDDPM (diffusion-based) methods, evaluating distribution similarity, correlation, density and coverage to produce privacy-preserving, augmented banking data. It carries an in-tree copy of the standalone CTGAN package (sdv-dev/CTGAN), whose TVAESynthesizer is imported and invoked directly in train_sample_tvae.py as a baseline synthesizer.
evidence: org-tab-ddpm/CTGAN/train_sample_tvae.py:5,41 imports and calls TVAESynthesizer from vendored CTGAN.ctgan (sdv-dev/CTGAN)
needs: The vendored CTGAN/TVAE copy appears to come from the TabDDPM benchmark suite as a baseline model rather than a deliberate integration by this repo's own README-described GReaT/TabDDPM pipeline; unclear how central it is to the project's actual results.
